title: Quantum Delayed Synchronization (QDS): Hahn-Echo T2 Sweep on IBM Hardware
description: U-delay-U† (Hahn-echo) versus U-delay (control) T2 sweep on IBM Quantum hardware (ibm_kingston, qubit 91), 5 runs with 1024 shots per circuit. Includes raw counts, evaluated statistics, circuit template SHA-256, and correlated T1/T2 multi-run drift analysis.
